title: A Sigil for the Wolf Anew
author: Sable Fairweather
blurb: Wendell Joubert, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
